'''JohnsonJedi The Never Ending Main Characters Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[JohnsonJedi]]
* '''Published:''' 11 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Spaceport Docking Bay|SE-L-spaceportdockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Spaceport Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Spaceport Docking Bay JohnsonJedi LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I had a hard time deciding which categorey to put this deck under but I have finally decided.This deck can really frustrate your opponent.

The published list has 66 cards.

== Strategy ==

As you can see it is a Tatooine deck thus it has utility belts and old bens.The strategy is to beat your opponent senseless with jedi and if they wipe out any of your main characters just use old ben or there particualar card that saves them.Also I use Talone Karrde and Leesub Sirin to take away one card from their hand and destroy it every turn.Another good thing about the fact that I am almost constantly on Tatooine is that most of my opponent's force drains get cancelled by Leia.
